patch_description:
Improve expressivity and accuracy by:
1. Converting all single-qubit RY gates to have individual parameters (ry_0 through ry_8) instead of shared ones, enabling per-qubit flexibility
2. Adding CCRZ three-qubit interactions on strategically selected triples to capture higher-order correlations without excessive parameter growth
3. Replacing fixed CZ gates with parametrized CRZ where beneficial to increase the circuit's learning capacity
4. Following the pattern that worked well in the second prior program which achieved 0.64 validation accuracy

This addresses the validation accuracy plateau by providing more fine-grained control over state transformations while leveraging three-qubit interactions proven to boost performance.
